author: Zintenka
body:
I know that there is some paranoia and caution against TNT based warfare but i think that'll be pretty fun. 

Maybe we can add this as a separate gamemode from Nebula called: Raid. 

It is extremely similar to Nebula except TNT and Firecharges are allowed. (Firecharges make great long ranged projectiles, i know there is the problem of firespread but that can be changed with with the gamerule command.)

There are two gamemodes: Arma and CTDM (Cannon TDM or Cannon Based TDM) 

Arma is based on the awesome MMOFPS called Arma: It is where you have a large map and you have to do multiple objectives in order to win. DTM mixed with TDM or even DTM mixed with CTH, vice versa. Cannons are allowed in order to bombard the enemy base blow up the objective: Monuments can be a material that is susceptible to explosions like gold, and defend your base from interlopers.

CTDM: As many of you know, it is based on two masses of land and you having to cannon the hell out of each other's base and get tons of kills. 

Fall damage is disabled and you cannot build across the void. In order to get across the map, you have to... :) ...Icarus yourself towards the enemy... "Feet First Into Hell!" -ODST Moto.

I understand the consequences of these risks, but they are necessary in order for Avicore or Avicus, (Plz change the name to Avicore... I'm confused by this point.) to grow! 

HOORAH!

replies.author: Lieutenantpants
replies.body:
There have been maps like that on other servers, where void bridging is not possible and you have to icarus over. Judging by the fact that you are currently on that server, I take it you know what map I'm talking about. The problem is that very few people actually know how to build and fire an effective icarus without either a. Teamgriefing, or b. Blowing themselves up. If Avicus were to have maps like that, you would need bridging capabilities. 
Also, cannon-TDMs have very poor gameplay, unless built very well and repeatedly tested prior to deployment to work out any bugs or issues with gameplay that exist. 
 Keep in mind that I'm not shooting this idea down. I would love for TNT gameplay to come to Avicus. But I think a meeting of sorts between Map Developers and members of the community who can bring up different sides of the spectrum would be necessary in order for this to begin development. Issues such as TNT teamgriefing would need to be addressed.
